paragraphs: INIT is a supplier of IT solutions for public transport, selling to operators around the world. Its systems cover all operational processes within a fully integrated ITS system.

Planning tools run from timetables through optimizing deployments to managing vehicles and drivers. Fare products handle smartcards, mobile tickets, ID- or account-based ticketing and Open Payment. Operations control covers monitoring the traffic situation, punctuality, disruption handling and passenger information. Transport companies can also use it for electromobility requirements and to set up a single sign-on mobility platform.

The company dates to 1983, when it started as a university spin-off. Its roots are in Karlsruhe, Germany. It reports more than 40 subsidiaries and offices around the globe. More than 1400 transport providers are described as relying on the company. Development and internal processes are stated to comply with IT security standards in accordance with DIN EN ISO/IEC 27001:2022.

quote.text: Digitalisation, Mobility as a Service, Electromobility: These developments will pose numerous challenges for public transport companies in the coming years.
